sources.title: AutoStore System FAQ
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 自動化立體倉庫
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：服務與等待定義一致，平均關係未被宣稱為尖峰保證，事件可追溯。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Service/wait definitions agree, mean relationships are not peak guarantees, and events are traceable.
related.difference: 區分平行運動的最大值與串聯時間加總，建立儲取事件時序。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish the maximum of parallel motions from summed sequential times, building a retrieval timeline.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Little關係L=λW使用含等待的總停留時間W；車隊尺度N≈λS/a使用每任務占用機器人的服務時間S及可用占比a。本無排隊簡化例才令W=S。 合成需求λ=0.20任務/s，每任務30 s，規劃可用占比0.75，忽略交通干擾。 L=0.20×30=6任務；N尺度=6/0.75=8台。此數不是等待時間保證。
恆速且兩軸同動時單程時間max(x/vx,y/vy)；往返加取放時間，忽略加減速是樂觀下界。 教學水平距離30 m、速度2 m/s，垂直12 m、速度1 m/s，取放合計10 s。 單程max(15,12)=15 s；週期2×15+10=40 s，理想吞吐3600/40=90次/h。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Little’s relationship L=λW uses total residence time W including waiting. Fleet scale N≈λS/a uses productive robot-occupancy time S and usable fraction a. Only this ideal no-queue case sets W=S. Synthetic demand 0.20 tasks/s,30 s/task, planned usable fraction 0.75, ignoring traffic interaction. L=6 tasks; fleet scale=6/0.75=8 robots, not a waiting-time guarantee.

At constant simultaneous speeds, one-way time=max(x/vx, y/vy); round-trip plus handling gives an optimistic bound omitting acceleration. Teaching horizontal 30 m at 2 m/s, vertical 12 m at 1 m/s, total handling 10 s. One-way=max(15,12)=15 s; cycle 40 s and ideal throughput 90 cycles/h.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 製造執行系統整合
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：服務與等待定義一致，平均關係未被宣稱為尖峰保證，事件可追溯。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Service/wait definitions agree, mean relationships are not peak guarantees, and events are traceable.
related.difference: 用工作訂單、工件與事件識別碼區分新完工、重送及更正，避免重複計產。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish new completions, retries and corrections using order, part and eventIDs to avoid duplicate production counts.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Little關係L=λW使用含等待的總停留時間W；車隊尺度N≈λS/a使用每任務占用機器人的服務時間S及可用占比a。本無排隊簡化例才令W=S。 合成需求λ=0.20任務/s，每任務30 s，規劃可用占比0.75，忽略交通干擾。 L=0.20×30=6任務；N尺度=6/0.75=8台。此數不是等待時間保證。
可重送訊息不等於可重複計數；以事件ID去重、以工件狀態機限制合法轉移，保存更正歷史。 合成100件唯一完工，97良品、3報廢；網路重送5筆良品事件，原始訊息共105筆。 去重良率97/100=97%；直接計訊息為102/105=97.1429%，且虛增5件。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Little’s relationship L=λW uses total residence time W including waiting. Fleet scale N≈λS/a uses productive robot-occupancy time S and usable fraction a. Only this ideal no-queue case sets W=S. Synthetic demand 0.20 tasks/s,30 s/task, planned usable fraction 0.75, ignoring traffic interaction. L=6 tasks; fleet scale=6/0.75=8 robots, not a waiting-time guarantee.

Retryable messages are not repeatable counts; deduplicate by eventID, enforce part-state transitions and retain correction history. Synthetic 100 unique completions,97 good and 3 scrap; five good-event retries produce 105 raw messages. Deduplicated yield 97%; naive message counting gives 102/105=97.1429% and five fictitious parts.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
